import pandas as pd

# File paths for all source tables
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_23/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_23/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_23/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_23/training_3.csv"
]

# Years corresponding to each source file in order
years = [2013, 2014, 2015, 2016]

# Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
# Each source has schema: ['Wrestler', 'Wins', 'Losses', 'Draws']
dfs = []
for file in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# Rename columns in each DataFrame to include the year suffix
# e.g. Wins -> 2013 Wins, Losses -> 2013 Losses, Draws -> 2013 Draws
for i, df in enumerate(dfs):
    year = years[i]
    df.rename(columns={
        'Wins': f'{year} Wins',
        'Losses': f'{year} Losses',
        'Draws': f'{year} Draws'
    }, inplace=True)

# Now we have 4 DataFrames with columns:
# ['Wrestler', '2013 Wins', '2013 Losses', '2013 Draws'], etc.

# Merge all DataFrames on 'Wrestler' using outer join to keep all wrestlers
# This will produce columns for all years side by side
df_merged = dfs[0]
for df in dfs[1:]:
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_merged, df, on='Wrestler', how='outer')

# Fill NaN values with 0 for all numeric columns (wins, losses, draws)
# Wrestler column is string, so exclude it
numeric_cols = df_merged.columns.drop('Wrestler')
df_merged[numeric_cols] = df_merged[numeric_cols].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'Wrestler',
    '2013 Wins', '2013 Losses', '2013 Draws',
    '2014 Wins', '2014 Losses', '2014 Draws',
    '2015 Wins', '2015 Losses', '2015 Draws',
    '2016 Wins', '2016 Losses', '2016 Draws'
]

df_final = df_merged[target_columns]

# Write the final DataFrame to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_23/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read each source with index_col=0 and add a year column
df_2013 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_23/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df_2013["Year"] = 2013

df_2014 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_23/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df_2014["Year"] = 2014

df_2015 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_23/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df_2015["Year"] = 2015

df_2016 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_23/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
df_2016["Year"] = 2016

# UNION all source tables
df_all = pd.concat([df_2013, df_2014, df_2015, df_2016], ignore_index=True)

# Pivot the data to get columns per year
# We want columns: '2013 Wins', '2013 Losses', '2013 Draws', ..., '2016 Draws'
# So pivot Wins, Losses, Draws by Year

df_pivot_wins = df_all.pivot_table(index="Wrestler", columns="Year", values="Wins", aggfunc='sum').fillna(0).astype(int)
df_pivot_losses = df_all.pivot_table(index="Wrestler", columns="Year", values="Losses", aggfunc='sum').fillna(0).astype(int)
df_pivot_draws = df_all.pivot_table(index="Wrestler", columns="Year", values="Draws", aggfunc='sum').fillna(0).astype(int)

# Rename columns to match target schema
df_pivot_wins.columns = [f"{year} Wins" for year in df_pivot_wins.columns]
df_pivot_losses.columns = [f"{year} Losses" for year in df_pivot_losses.columns]
df_pivot_draws.columns = [f"{year} Draws" for year in df_pivot_draws.columns]

# Combine all into one dataframe
df_final = pd.concat([df_pivot_wins, df_pivot_losses, df_pivot_draws], axis=1).reset_index()

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = ['Wrestler',
                  '2013 Wins', '2013 Losses', '2013 Draws',
                  '2014 Wins', '2014 Losses', '2014 Draws',
                  '2015 Wins', '2015 Losses', '2015 Draws',
                  '2016 Wins', '2016 Losses', '2016 Draws']

# Some wrestlers may not appear in all years, ensure all columns exist
for col in target_columns:
    if col not in df_final.columns:
        df_final[col] = 0

df_final = df_final[target_columns]

# Write output
df_final.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_23/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
